children: First Breach installed new ammunition-loading and inspection equipment that expands capacity to produce up to 20 million rounds per month.
New loading and inspection equipment is installed and operational at Hagerstown, Maryland facility.
Production capacity increases by ~175%, enabling up to 20 million rounds per month.
Company is transitioning to a 24-hour production schedule to meet strong market demand.
Expansion complements First Breach’s drone manufacturing efforts as part of a broader U.S.-made defense platform.
